description: Image Description: The image displays three electronic devices placed side by side on a light wooden surface. On the left is a blue Game Boy Advance SP, a handheld gaming console with a clamshell design. Its screen is turned on, showing a colorful pixelated game scene with text at the top reading "THE LADY IS COOL." Below the screen are the control buttons, including a directional pad on the left, two action buttons (A and B) on the right, and a central start
